maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring SaaS subscriptions for payroll and HCM software, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private employers (boutiques, franchises, manufacturers, sports teams) paying for payroll and HR software.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its HCM platform to new clients; Airbase was a notable deal but not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Core payroll, tax filing and HR platform; switching means migration, retraining and payroll accuracy and compliance risk.
